findings.title: `sales` re-delivers every line of `orderrows` — one fact, twice
findings.finding: 223,974 rows each. `sales` carries all but 1 column of `orderrows` (RowNumber is spelled differently there), plus 7: CurrencyCode, CustomerKey, DeliveryDate, ExchangeRate, LineNumber, OrderDate, StoreKey. So `sales` answers at this grain with NO join, and `orderrows` cannot answer at all without a header relation. Only one is served, so the ambiguity is latent rather than live.
